{{Top|leg}}
'''Briefing Room 1''' was a briefing room on the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']], used to prepare [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]]s for upcoming missions. This larger briefing room was used by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] to brief pilots on [[Operation Strike Fear]] and the mission that would lead to the [[Battle of Brigia (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Brigia]]. [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] attended that briefing.<ref name="Strategy Guide">''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This room could be a room seen in the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] game, but while General Dodonna runs this briefing in ''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]'',<ref name="Strategy Guide" /> the mission briefings are given by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] in the game itself.<ref name="X-Wing">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref>
